S1_inst_clean.brief:
Material: Harbor Growth Fund III pitch deck (8 pages, deal-related), sponsored by Northbridge Advisors, growth equity in European software.
Lane: institutional - banker declares institutional investors only, controlled distribution; page 1 legend plus a footer on every page. Lighter review applies; no formatting, emphasis or complexity points.
Tier A is clean: Finalis incorporation-by-reference and broker-dealer block on pages 2 and 8 at 8.5 pt, institutional legend on page 1. No placement or legibility issue.
Coverage is unusually good: page 2 carries forward-looking/projections-may-not-be-realized, past performance not indicative (repeated on page 5), risk of loss, illiquidity, the verbatim SOP preferred-return text and the logo line; pages 5 and 6 both carry source lines.
Consequently B1, B3, B4 and both A7 candidates are suppressed on coverage, not on judgement.
Points that matter: one unsupported return characterization on page 3 ("attractive risk-adjusted return potential") - ask to source or soften.
To escalate: page 5 shows DPI for Fund II only while Fund I (2014-2022) shows TVPI alone - confirm this is not selective metric presentation under 2210(d)(1)(D).
To confirm: the reasonable basis, criteria and key assumptions behind the 2.5x net TVPI target are documented and retained, even though the target is correctly labelled, stated net and cross-referenced to page 2.
No projections-as-expected-outcomes, no superlatives, no comparisons, no logos, testimonials or awards in the deck.

unsupported_claims.why: The page 3 "attractive risk-adjusted return potential" claim is the one return characterization with no basis cited on its page.

S2_inst_gaps.brief:
Material: Meridian Infrastructure Partners IV pitch deck, nine pages, deal-related, prepared by the banker at Northbridge Advisors, distributed by email.
Lane: institutional (institutional investors only, controlled distribution) - lighter review, no formatting, emphasis or complexity points.
Already covered: page 2 carries forward-looking/targeted-return language with assumptions and "actual results may differ materially", the past-performance line, and high-degree-of-risk, full-loss and illiquidity wording; page 5 carries an audited source and the net-of-fees basis; page 8 cross-references page 2 for the target IRR.
Required blocks: the deterministic scan reports the Finalis disclaimer (with the broker-dealer line) and the "For institutional investors only" legend on page 1 as missing - both need to be added before release.
Points that matter: item-specific disclosures not covered anywhere - preferred return (p8), third-party partner/lender logos (p7), and the cover award methodology (p1); plus a missing source line on the projected deployment exhibit (p9).
Language: "delivers superior returns" (p3) is the one genuinely promissory statement and should be reworded; "the leading ... platform in Europe" (p1) and the $1.2 trillion figure (p3) need softening or sourcing.
Not raised: B1 and B3 (covered by page 2 and page 5), the p8 target IRR framing, p6 portfolio logos, and the p5 exhibit source.
Escalate: nothing requires escalation; the deck is otherwise clean for institutional distribution once the blocks and the four disclosures are in.

unsupported_claims.why: The cover's "leading platform in Europe", the award with no methodology, and the $1.2 trillion market figure are stated as fact with no source or criteria.

promised_results.why: Page 3 asserts that the sourcing engine "delivers superior returns", which states an outcome rather than an objective, although the IRR figures themselves are properly labelled as targets.

quartus.brief:
Material: Quartus AI Fund II LP pitch deck (28 pages, deal-related, prepared by the banker at Northbridge Advisors), distributed by email and in meetings.
Lane: institutional (institutional investors only, controlled distribution) - lighter review, no formatting, emphasis or complexity points, fair-and-balanced judged once at document level.
Already covered: disclaimers page 3 (forward-looking statements, past performance not indicative, risk of loss, confidentiality), key risk factors page 4 (risk of loss, no assurance of targeted returns, lack of liquidity), sources on page 15, assumption footnotes and express cross-references to page 3 on pages 9, 16, 20 and 25. B1, B2, B3 and the illiquidity line are therefore not raised.
Points that matter: B8 - the cover award has no awarding-body, criteria, period or fee footnote; B6 - service-provider logos on page 23 need the logo line on that page; B4 - the 8% preferred return on page 27 has no item-specific disclosure (desk practice: add the SOP text to page 3 and footnote page 27); A7 - the page 16 chart has no source line, the illustrative legend does not substitute.
Language: C1 superlatives on pages 1, 6 and 21; C2 "to deliver strong risk-adjusted returns" on page 6; C4 the unsourced "trillions of dollars" figure on page 6; C6 the peer-valuation comparison on page 22 needs a basis or softening.
To escalate / confirm: page 27 sets a $100K minimum for individual investors while the questionnaire declares institutional-only - confirm the audience and distribution control before the deck is released, since natural-person recipients would move this into the retail lane and bring RN 20-21 into play for the projected MOIC and target return figures.
Tier A required blocks were computed deterministically and are handled outside this list.

unsupported_claims.why: Self-characterizations ("AI pioneers", "state-of-the-art", "investor of choice"), the "trillions of dollars" figure on page 6 and the lower-valuation-than-peers comparison on page 22 are stated as fact with no source or criteria on those pages.

raised: "We believe … best" or "largest global institutions", page 6
